description: This file defines a C# class GrainServiceTestGrain implementing the IGrainServiceTestGrain interface, which acts as a grain in Orleans. It contains methods that invoke corresponding methods on an injected client service, ITestGrainServiceClient.

classes.name: GrainServiceTestGrain
classes.description: A Grain class in Orleans framework that interacts with an external grain service client, implementing interface IGrainServiceTestGrain.

methods.name: GetHelloWorldUsingCustomService
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes the testGrainServiceClient to retrieve a 'Hello World' message.

methods.name: CallHasStarted
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether the service has started.

methods.name: CallHasStartedInBackground
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether the service has started in the background.

methods.name: CallHasInit
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether the service has been initialized.

methods.name: GetServiceConfigProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property value from the service asynchronously.

methods.name: EchoViaExtension
methods.description: Sends a string 'what' to the service and retrieves the echoed response asynchronously.
